time_convention: t = frame / fps, frame 0 at t = 0
units: pixels (full 4096x2160 resolution) and seconds; no metric scale

camera.motion: static (overhead, looking straight down at a white desk)
camera.measured_background_shift_px: phase correlation of 4 static patches vs frame 0: |shift| < 1 px in every frame (compression jitter); see camera_shift.json
camera.perspective: near-orthographic top-down view; desk plane roughly parallel to the image; objects lie on the desk except the hands/held card which are a few cm above it

right_hand.description: right hand + forearm entering from the bottom (x~2900-3500), typing on the keyboard; the larger mover
right_hand.visible_frames: 0-27 (forearm cut by bottom image edge, occluded=1 means arm truncated by frame edge)
right_hand.motion: hand lifts and slides up-left over the keyboard frames 6-12, holds near keys frames 12-16, slides back down-right frames 17-23, then rests/types at the original spot 23-27
right_hand.ref_point: ref_x/ref_y = centroid of the hand part of the skin mask (skin pixels within 450 px of the fingertip extreme along the arm direction (0.25,-1)); tip_x/tip_y = fingertip extreme

left_hand.description: left hand + forearm from bottom-left (x~1520 at bottom edge), holding the black Visa card between thumb and fingers
left_hand.motion: almost static; drifts ~18 px up-left frames 8-11 and back ~8 px frames 18-25
left_hand.ref_point: centroid of skin pixels within 450 px of the fingertip extreme along (0.6,-0.8)

visa_card.description: black Visa card held by the left hand (VISA logo bottom-right, name 'ALEXANDRA TISHKOVA'), above the wallet
visa_card.visible_frames: 0-27, left end partly covered by thumb/fingers
visa_card.motion: moves with the left hand: ~15 px up-left frames 8-11, small return frames 20-25
visa_card.ref_point: centre of the min-area rectangle of the convex hull of the dark card mask

size_px.length: 353.6-355.4 (long side, axis ~155-157 deg i.e. tilted ~24 deg, rising to the right)
size_px.width: 193-204 (short side; affected by finger occlusion and tilt of the card out of the desk plane)

keyboard.description: white/silver Apple wireless keyboard, right-centre, rotated ~37 deg (long axis down-right)
keyboard.notes: manual corners +-8 px; length = long side incl. battery bar ends; partially covered by right hand

mouse.description: white Apple Magic Mouse, bottom-right, long axis ~56 deg from horizontal (top end to the upper right)
mouse.notes: low-contrast white on white; length +-12 px

wallet.description: black zippered leather wallet / coin purse below the Visa card, with zipper tab and round gold charm at its bottom
wallet.notes: body from dark mask with the thin zipper tab removed (+-25 px); full dark mask incl. tab: bbox above, centroid [2694,1688]

second_card.description: second black card lying on the desk under the right wrist (text 'grind.co.uk'), right of the wallet
second_card.notes: middle always hidden by the right forearm; length from extrapolated edges +-12 px; best visible frames 12-16

pin_tin.description: round metal tin of pins/clips, top-right

plant.description: green potted plant (leaves) top-left, pot hidden under leaves, cut by top image edge
plant.notes: green leaf mask; extends past top edge

clipboard.description: wooden clipboard with white paper and black metal clip, bottom-left, rotated 45 deg; runs off the left and bottom image edges
clipboard.clip_px: black clip from about (40,1600) to (380,1290), ~420 px along the board edge

pen.description: transparent pen with dark ink tube lying on the clipboard paper

desk.description: white desk surface filling the frame

events.event: start: right fingers on keyboard (typing pose), left hand holds Visa card
right hand starts moving up-left across keyboard
right hand reaches upper-left position (fingertips near number row, tip_y ~947)
right hand back at original position (motion ends ~frame 24)
left hand + card start a small (~15-18 px) up-left shift, ending frame 11
